exact: aromatic amino acid family biosynthetic process, anthranilate pathway

definition: The chemical reactions and pathways resulting in the formation of L-tryptophan, the chiral amino acid 2-amino-3-(1H-indol-3-yl)propanoic acid; L-tryptophan is synthesized from chorismate via anthranilate.
label: L-tryptophan biosynthetic process
